points.title: ENZO Points
points.intro: Every order brings you closer to the next one. Collect points and spend them as money off at checkout.
points.signInToCollect: or create an account to start collecting points — guest orders don't earn points.
points.howEarn: Orders of 100 ILS or more earn 500 points for every full 100 ILS (worth 5 ILS). Points land in your account the moment you order.
points.howUse: 100 points = 1 ILS. At checkout, choose how many points to use and they come straight off your items (not delivery).
points.cancel: If an order is cancelled, its points are taken back and any points you spent on it come back to you. Returning items adjusts the points the same way.
points.rateNote: Points are counted on what you pay for items after discounts, without the delivery fee.

tour.welcomeText: You're signed in and you'll stay signed in on this device. Here's a 30-second look at how the shop works.
tour.browseText: Open Shop from the menu. Pick a category at the top, then tap the sizes you wear — tick "In stock only" to see just what's available now.
tour.colorsText: On a product, choose the color first: the sizes update to what's actually in stock in that color. Sizes marked "Sold out" can't be picked.
tour.checkoutText: Add to cart, choose your delivery area (West Bank 20 ₪, Jerusalem 30 ₪, Inside 70 ₪) and pay cash on delivery. Have a discount code? Enter it in the order summary.
tour.pointsText: Orders of 100 ₪ or more earn 500 points for every 100 ₪ — that's 5 ₪ off your next order. Use them at checkout (100 points = 1 ₪).
tour.trackText: After ordering, follow it step by step: received, confirmed, on the way, delivered. Find it under My account or Track order in the menu.
tour.helpText: Questions about sizes or an order? Tap the WhatsApp button at the bottom of any page and we'll answer.
